intro: Step into Burdur Museum, in Burdur province, founded in 1969. It holds the finds of the Sagalassos excavation, and with them the Neolithic painted pottery of the Hacılar mound.
history: The museum was founded in 1969 and holds the fullest collection from Pisidia. Here the sculpture of the Sagalassos excavation and the Neolithic painted pottery of the Hacılar mound share one roof, with about seven thousand years between the two sequences.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the sculpture from Sagalassos and the Hacılar pottery. Pause before the Roman portraits, and end in the Ethnography hall.
facts: Did you know? The colossal head and foot of Hadrian from Sagalassos come from a statue of the emperor five metres tall. And about seven thousand years sit under one roof here: Neolithic Hacılar pots beside Roman sculpture.
outro: This brings our tour of Burdur Museum to an end. Before you go, a small request: please leave the objects untouched and take your photographs without flash. Thank you for your time, and enjoy your visit.
